libraryDescription: Choose the directory for your sorted media library.
stagingDescription: Choose the staging directory for incoming media.
structureDescription: Configure how your library is organized on disk.
indexingDescription: Scan your library and staging directories.
cacheDescription: Manage cached thumbnails and disk usage.
updatesDescription: Keep track of the current application version.
previewNotice: UI preview · Changes are not applied or saved.
saveNotice: Changes apply after Save changes. Scanning uses saved directories. Disk synchronization runs in the background when enabled.
copyrightDescription: Use the first alphabetically sorted copyright as a folder. Saved changes reorganize existing distributed files when sync is enabled.
artistDescription: Use the file’s single artist as a folder. Saved changes reorganize existing distributed files when sync is enabled.
separatorDescription: Separator between character names in filenames.
videoFolderDescription: Name of the subfolder for video files.
gifDescription: Subfolder for GIF files when disk sync is enabled. Leave empty to omit this level. Saved changes reorganize existing distributed GIFs.
syncDescription: When on, existing distributed files gradually move into the configured structure. When off, distribution saves metadata and leaves files in place; pending moves pause after the current operation.
autoScanDescription: Scan Library and Stage each time Nexa opens.
importDescription: Copy Library, Stage and metadata into the new database. Old data and media files stay unchanged. Existing files are skipped.
importNotice: Characters keep their copyright; tags are shared without duplicates. Imported roots are retained without changing your settings. Stage shows files from its saved directory and redistribution queue. Main shows files from the saved Library directory.
clearDescription: Remove cached thumbnails and temporary files.
autoUpdateDescription: Check for updates each time Nexa opens.
checkDescription: Manually check for a newer version.
installNotice: Nexa will close and restart during installation. Save unfinished edits first.
themeDescription: More themes will be available later.
searchFiles: Search files by name or path
tagContext: Add a little context to this file.
tagDemoNotice: Choose an existing tag or create your own. Changes are stored for this demo session.
languageDescription: Interface language. Applies after saving changes.
selectOne: Select one file to view its information.
adjustFilters: Try another search or adjust your filters.
stageEmpty: Your staging files will appear here.
favoritesEmpty: Tap the heart on a file to keep it here.
legacyCheckError: Could not check for old Nexa data: {error}
importResult: Import complete: {libraryAdded} Library files and {stageAdded} Stage files added. {skipped} existing files skipped.
